purpose: Candidate evidence for the canonical feature report. This file owns Slice 1 test mappings only; it does not mark canonical features complete.
platform: macOS arm64; Linux and Windows execution remain pending CI.

validation.laterSchemaOnlySseSampleChecks: The backend's separate 160-sample type proof is not runtime full-SSE replay evidence.

features.proves: The actual session-create capture matches all fresh metadata fields, including timestamps under explicit pointer rules, idle status, zero usage/context/turns, empty queue/jobs, nullable conversation/goal/loop/worktree and false pinned/archived.
A completed session restarts idle with an identical full session response and conversation, usage and final events retained.
features.pending: Recovery of running, goal, queue, loop and job state remains for the owning slices.

features.proves: Two FIFO text sends finish as two turns without a stranded queued message in the controlled scenario.

features.proves: The same GUI token survives a real shutdown and restart.

features.pending: The fake supports up to 8 MB, but 8 MB and malformed oversized lines remain for adapter tests.

features.proves: The fake exits with code 23; the whole engine reports a durable error notice, returns idle and accepts session deletion.
Exactly 22 distinct of 172 captured cases pass, including one events-sse case with eight original samples. Exact decimal equality preserves large distinct integers; unknown dynamic rules fail.
features.pending: The other 150 cases and the remaining 65 routes stay pending; no broad field exclusions or full-contract parity claim.

limitations: Every Passing subset entry has additional acceptance behavior pending; combine other owned evidence before changing its canonical status.
All application goals, approval flows, handoff, cooldowns, jobs, loop, schedule, worktrees, terminal and dictation remain pending their slices.
The harness uses only disposable synthetic data under Desktop/test. No real agy calls or real credentials are used.
Fake protocol controls, cancellation and sandbox tests do not prove application implementations of the pending features.
Mixed Python/Rust locking, real account continuity, native desktop tests and paid live smoke tests remain separate gates.

Independent review found stop-descendant/stderr hangs and loss of an init conversation id on crash. The existing passing suite does not prove those cases; the overall slice remains held until targeted regressions and fixes pass.
